newsitem.title: UK: SBC sets call and put warrants on German stocks.
newsitem.headline: SBC sets call and put warrants on German stocks.

text.p: Schweizerischer Bankverein (Deutschland) says it has issued 10 million American-style call and put warrants, in 10 equal tranches, on German stocks including Commerzbank AG, Daimler-Benz AG, Bayerische Motoren-Werke AG (BMW), BASF AG and Bayer AG.
